thread:
ryan: Hey team, first week and hitting an MDM snag. Trying to enroll a personal Framework laptop (Fedora 36) into Kandji/Fleet for VPN and private repos. Enrollment fails with 'os-version-policy' and 'disk-encryption-mismatch'. I do have LUKS but the installer shows LVM on top. Anyone seen this?
it-support: Welcome, Ryan! We prefer company hardware but we support exceptions. Quick ask: did you set up LVM during install? Our FDE detector expects a standard LUKS partition without LVM layers by default. Can you paste `lsblk -f` and `cat /etc/fedora-release`?

ryan: `lsblk -f` shows nvme0p2 crypto_LUKS with lvm on top (vg0/root). Fedora 36.

ops: That's the issue — our enrollment agent doesn't detect inline LUKS when LVM is present because the header is on a physical partition but there are logical volumes after opening. We can add a policy exception for this device type but security approval required.

security: We can allow read-only repo access for now without full FDE compliance. VPN and deploy key use require the full policy (LUKS header on internal plain partition + TPM2 sealing preferred). If you want to convert to a plain LUKS layout, it requires backup, recreate partitions, and restore. We can walk you through it.

ryan: I'd rather not reformat right away. Is there a temporary path?
it-support: Two immediate paths: 1) We can provision a cloud-dev VM with repo + VPN-lite access for 7 days (no enrollment). 2) We issue a time-limited user token + SSH bastion access after security signs exception (usually 24-72h). Which works?

ryan: Cloud VM for now, please. Also curious if the agent can be updated to support LVM LUKS detection — many linux distros default to that.

ops: Filed feature request: KANDJI-3492 — improve FDE detection for LVM-on-LUKS. Adding product engineering to review.

kandji-bot: Compliance alert  Enrollment blocked: FDE_MISMATCH. Ticket CMP-7810 created.

it-support: Cloud-dev vm ready (ryan-dev-04). SSH details DM'd. TTL 168h. If you later decide to use this machine permanently, open a ticket and we'll coordinate imaging/loaner process.

ryan: Thanks all, connecting now. Appreciate the quick help :grinning:
